title: Chance-Constrained Inspection Viewpoint Sequencing for On-Orbit Servicing via Safe Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41639v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous inspection of a target spacecraft is typically the initial step in on-orbit servicing. Planning close-proximity observation viewpoints involves a complex combinatorial problem constrained by coverage, fuel, and safety considerations. This paper models the viewpoint selection as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and applies Proximal Policy Optimization with Lagrangian relaxation to solve it. The system combines a high-level planner, which sequences camera viewpoints on an observation sphere around the target, with a low-level model that assesses each transfer using the Clohessy--Wiltshire (CW) equations for relative motion. The deterministic constraints on single-impulse reachability and $\Delta v$ cap are enforced directly on the action set. translated_title: 基于安全强化学习的在轨服务机会约束检查视点排序
translated_abstract: 自主检查目标航天器通常是在轨服务的第一步。规划近距离观测视点涉及一个受覆盖范围、燃料和安全性等多重约束的复杂组合问题。本文将视点选择建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），并应用带拉格朗日松弛的近端策略优化（PPO）方法进行求解。该系统将高层规划器与低层模型相结合：高层规划器在围绕目标的观测球面上对相机视点进行排序，低层模型则使用Clohessy–Wiltshire（CW）相对运动方程评估每次转移。单脉冲可达性和Δv上限等确定性约束被直接施加于动作集合上。由于安全裕度受导航和机动误差的影响，实际的安全间隙具有随机性。为解决这一问题，本文对实际飞行轨迹实施了机会约束。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于安全强化学习的方法，将在轨服务中的检查视点排序建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，利用带拉格朗日松弛的PPO求解，并通过机会约束处理导航与机动误差导致的随机性安全问题。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates inspection viewpoint sequencing for on-orbit servicing as a Constrained Markov Decision Process solved by PPO with Lagrangian relaxation, introducing chance constraints to handle the stochastic safety margins caused by navigation and maneuver errors.
